messages:
Lina Chen: Hey folks — quick idea: I think we should assemble a lightweight 'stitching' playbook for partner IaC connectors that glues marketplace quickstarts + our Terraform modules + CI smoke checks. Goal: partners can drop a single overlay and get a validated deployment in <30 mins. Thoughts?
Marcus Patel: love it. can we scope it to 1) gcp/aws marketplaces, 2) an ampere/graviton note, and 3) a minimal smoke test matrix?
Lina Chen: yes. scope proposed: quickstart template (1-click), repo with overlay examples (tf + k8s), CI jobs (smoke + lint), and a short runbook for partners to customize. keep it opinionated.
Oliver Reyes: +1. we should include a small compatibility table for instance types and a fallback plan when target shapes aren't available (fallback to cpu or smaller gpu). also add example tf snippet for how to reference our module in a partner overlay:
Oliver Reyes: ```
module "redwood_inference" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-modules//refkits/quickstart"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = var.instance_type
}
```
Tia Morgan: who owns ship? I'd suggest Partnerships owns the playbook content, Eng-Platform owns the module bits and CI templates, and Docs owns the short partner runbook. I'll coordinate owners if we agree.
Lina Chen: that ownership split works. Marcus — can you volunteer to draft the repo skeleton and the sample overlay for AWS?
Marcus Patel: yep, I'll put a skeleton under partner-stitching-playbook/aws-overlay and add a basic CI file using our standard smoke job. will ping when PR ready.
InfraBot: Jenkins job created: job/marketplace-stitching-smoke (build #1 queued)
Oliver Reyes: For smoke matrix let's keep it tiny: create, basic inference call, teardown. Inference call can be a curl against the quickstart endpoint with a short prompt. Also include token/cost guidance in comments.
Lina Chen: good call. sample smoke command: `curl -s -X POST https://example.local/generate -d '{"input":"hi"}'` — we can template that.
Tia Morgan: timeline? I'd like a first draft + PR in two weeks so partners at summit can preview.
Marcus Patel: two weeks is fine. aiming for draft by 3651235200 (PR in repo).
Lina Chen: I'll start a one-pager with links and the compatibility matrix template. Will drop it here once done.
Oliver Reyes: also add a short troubleshooting checklist: common IAM errors, missing AMIs, kubeadm taints, and how to run local smoke with docker-compose.
Lina Chen: noted. thanks everyone — leaving this thread open for small updates. :thumbsup:
